message.content: I have rheumatoid arthritis and have been living with interstitial lung disease for about five years. I take baricitinib and methotrexate for my condition, and I’ve also had exposure to asbestos materials in the past. As for your other questions, I don't have any known heart disease or other lung conditions like asthma or COPD. I haven't traveled recently, and I'm not aware of any sick contacts or specific exposures to birds or mold.
